quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #18
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 32

questions.question: Which statement is true?

options.text: Signal at least 100 feet before changing lanes to pass. Make sure no cars are coming toward you.
Use your mirrors and look over your left shoulder to check your blind spot when passing.
Wait until you see both headlights of the car you passed in your rearview mirror before moving back to your lane.

questions.explanation: When passing, always signal 100 feet before you change lanes. Check your mirrors and look over your shoulder for blind spots. Wait until you see both headlights of the passed car in your rearview mirror before returning to your lane.

questions.question: What driving technique helps you avoid crashes on icy or snowy roads?

options.text: Add extra weight to your vehicle for better grip.
Leave the highway as soon as possible.
Slow down and stay farther behind other cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and stay farther behind other cars.
questions.explanation: Reduce your speed on snow or ice. Slowing down and increasing your following distance are the best ways to avoid crashes in bad weather.

questions.question: When can you drive faster than the speed limit?

options.text: When a police officer is not around.
When other cars around you are speeding.
When you are in a hurry.

questions.explanation: Always follow the speed limit. Driving at safe speeds gives you time to change lanes, slow down, or stop if something unexpected happens.

questions.question: Another driver is passing your car. What should you do?

options.text: Signal to tell the driver when it is safe to pass.
Check for oncoming traffic and adjust your speed to help them pass safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for oncoming traffic and adjust your speed to help them pass safely.
questions.explanation: Stay to the right when another driver passes you on the left. Check for oncoming traffic and adjust your speed so the passing car can move back into the right lane easily.

questions.question: This sign shows:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is ahead where another road crosses.

questions.question: What do downward-pointing triangle signs mean?
questions.explanation: Downward-pointing triangle signs tell drivers to yield. Slow down and check for traffic or pedestrians. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: Another car is about to hit you. What should you do?
questions.explanation: Use your horn to warn other drivers or pedestrians who may not see you. For example, honk if you think another driver is about to hit you.

questions.question: Which statement about winter driving is false?

options.text: Winter is the hardest season for driving.
Check your antifreeze and windshield washer fluid often in winter.
Using cruise control in winter weather is safe.
Using snow tires helps your vehicle grip the road better.

questions.correctAnswerText: Using cruise control in winter weather is safe.
questions.explanation: Do not use cruise control on snow, rain, fog, or other hazardous conditions. Winter driving is dangerous and requires extra care. Check antifreeze and windshield washer fluid regularly. Snow tires improve traction on slippery roads.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a traffic light is coming. Be ready to stop for a yellow or red light.

questions.question: On horizontal traffic lights, where is the green light?
questions.explanation: Some cities use horizontal traffic lights. On these lights, red is on the left, yellow is in the middle, and green is on the right.

questions.question: When you see an accident, you should:

options.text: Stop if you are involved or if no emergency help is there yet.

questions.explanation: Do not stop at an accident unless you are involved or emergency help has not arrived. Watch the road carefully and keep moving. Watch for people on or near the road. Do not drive to an accident, fire, or disaster just to look.

questions.question: A seat belt should fit:

options.text: Snug across your hip bones and lower belly.
So the buzzer or light does not work.

questions.correctAnswerText: Snug across your hip bones and lower belly.
questions.explanation: The lap belt should fit snugly across your hip bones and lower belly. The shoulder belt should fit comfortably so you can fit your fist between the belt and your chest.

questions.question: You are approaching a railroad crossing with no gates or flashing lights, but with a crossbuck sign. You should:

options.text: Approach with extreme caution and cross only when you know no train is coming.
Turn your radio down to listen for a train.
Continue only when a flagger tells you it is safe.

questions.explanation: Always approach railroad crossings with extreme caution. Cross only when you are sure no train is coming from either direction. If a flagger is present, obey all their instructions.

questions.question: Drivers who eat and drink while driving:

options.text: Are better drivers because they are not hungry.

questions.explanation: Eating, drinking, or smoking while driving is dangerous. These actions take your hands off the wheel and your eyes off the road. Drivers who do these things have trouble staying in their lanes and controlling their vehicles.

questions.question: A person walking with a white cane or guide dog is likely:
questions.explanation: Always give the right-of-way to a pedestrian who is blind and using a white cane or guide dog.

questions.question: Traffic moving in opposite directions is separated by ____ lines.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic that moves in opposite directions.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction are about to become one.

questions.question: You must stop at an intersection when you see:
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same as a stop sign. Come to a complete stop, look both ways, and go only when the intersection is clear.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead has one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead fits only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that the bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck. Be careful and slow down.

questions.question: What should you do if your right wheels leave the pavement?

options.text: Pull all the way off the road and get back on when safe.
Speed up and steer back on quickly.
Take your foot off the gas, slow down, then ease back onto the road when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take your foot off the gas, slow down, then ease back onto the road when safe.
questions.explanation: Do not panic if your right wheels leave the pavement. Take your foot off the gas and steer parallel to the road. Slow down and ease back onto the road by keeping both hands on the wheel and turning gently into the right lane. Check for traffic before steering back onto the pavement.

questions.question: A steady yellow traffic light means a ____ light will appear soon.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light tells you that a steady red light is coming soon.

questions.question: Drivers must yield to a pedestrian:

options.text: Even if the pedestrian crosses carelessly.
Only when the pedestrian is in a crosswalk.
Only if the pedestrian is on the same side of the road.
If the pedestrian uses a hand signal to stop traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Even if the pedestrian crosses carelessly.
questions.explanation: Drivers must always yield to pedestrians, even if they cross against the light or are being careless.

questions.question: Hydroplaning is usually caused by:
questions.explanation: When you drive too fast, your tires cannot clear water from the road. They lose their grip, and your vehicle slides on a film of water. This is hydroplaning.

questions.question: Louisiana law requires headlights to be used:

options.text: When the temperature drops below freezing.
During the day in good weather.

questions.explanation: Louisiana law requires headlights to be on between sunset and sunrise. Use low beams, not bright lights, when within 500 feet of or following another vehicle within 200 feet.

questions.question: A red arrow on a traffic light means:

options.text: A driver must proceed slowly through the intersection.
A driver must stop and then go when the way is clear.
A driver must stop and then go when a green light or green arrow appears.
A driver may turn in the direction the arrow points.

questions.correctAnswerText: A driver must stop and then go when a green light or green arrow appears.
questions.explanation: A red arrow means you must stop completely. You may only go when a green light or green arrow appears, unless a sign says otherwise.

questions.question: When driving in traffic, it is safest to:

options.text: Change your speed often to stay alert.
Drive faster than the other traffic.
Drive slower than the other traffic.

questions.explanation: Crashes happen when drivers go faster or slower than other vehicles. Always drive with the flow of traffic, within the speed limit.

questions.question: When a traffic light turns green, you should:

options.text: Speed up as fast as possible.
Wait until another driver waves you on.

questions.explanation: A green light means you can go. But first, yield to pedestrians and other vehicles still in the intersection.

questions.question: What does the "I" in the SIPDE acronym mean?
questions.explanation: The "I" stands for "Identify hazards." This means you should notice road signs and features, and spot anything that could cause problems.

questions.question: When two vehicles enter an intersection at the same time, which must yield?
questions.explanation: When two vehicles arrive at an intersection at the same time, the vehicle on the left must yield to the vehicle on the right.

questions.question: This shape and color sign is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign means no passing zone.

questions.question: How do you enter a freeway?

options.text: Signal, yield to traffic already on the freeway, and match their speed.
Signal and enter. Freeway traffic must yield to you.
Drive slowly so you can check the traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal, yield to traffic already on the freeway, and match their speed.
questions.explanation: Signal and match the speed of traffic already on the freeway. Always yield to other vehicles when entering a roadway.

questions.question: When changing lanes, what should you NOT do?

options.text: Check your side and rearview mirrors.
Use your turn signal to show other drivers your plan.
Check for other drivers moving into your lane.
Call police on your cell phone to ask if the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Call police on your cell phone to ask if the road is clear.
questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check your mirrors for traffic behind you. Use your turn signal to alert other drivers. Look for other drivers who may also be moving into your lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Do not drink if you plan to drive.
The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What do two solid yellow lines on the road mean?

options.text: Passing is allowed from both directions.
Passing is allowed at the top of a hill.
Passing is allowed during the day only.

questions.explanation: Yellow lines mean traffic on the other side is moving toward you. Never cross two solid yellow lines to pass, from either direction.

questions.question: When driving near a motorcycle, you must:

options.text: Give the motorcycle a full lane to use.
Drive on the shoulder next to the motorcycle.
Let the motorcycle share half your lane.
Pass the motorcycle in the same lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the motorcycle a full lane to use.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles are full vehicles with the same rights as other vehicles. Give motorcyclists a full lane width. They need space to move safely, even if there seems to be room to share a lane.

questions.question: If a driver is worried, nervous, angry, or crying, they:

options.text: Will drive the same as if they were thinking clearly.
Can drive faster because they are more alert.
Should calm down and focus before starting to drive.
Should call a friend to talk while driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should calm down and focus before starting to drive.
questions.explanation: Strong emotions can distract you from driving because your mind is focused on something else. Calm down and get focused before you start driving.

questions.question: When making a right turn, your car should be:

options.text: Near the center of the street.
Close to the left side of the street.
Close to the right side of the street.
Past the center of the intersection before turning.

questions.correctAnswerText: Close to the right side of the street.
questions.explanation: Get as far to the right side of the road as possible before turning right. Do not cut across other lanes to make a turn.

questions.question: How can you avoid making emergency stops while driving in traffic?

options.text: Honk your horn to alert other drivers.
Look ahead and stay a safe distance behind other cars.
Drive in the right lane only.
Drive slower than the traffic around you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look ahead and stay a safe distance behind other cars.
questions.explanation: A safe following distance lets you react to problems ahead without hard braking. This protects the driver behind you from hitting your vehicle.

questions.question: When you see a flashing red traffic light, you must:
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. Yield to traffic and pedestrians, then go when it is safe. At railroad crossings, a flashing red light means a train is coming. Yield to the train and go only when lights stop flashing and warning devices turn off.

questions.question: When should drivers use hand-to-hand steering?

options.text: When turning the wheel during normal driving.
When avoiding a hazard at high speed.
When turning the wheel at low speeds.
When backing up, using signals, using the radio, or using windshield wipers.

questions.correctAnswerText: When turning the wheel during normal driving.
questions.explanation: Use hand-to-hand steering while driving normally at speeds above 15 mph. This is also called push/pull steering.
